sentences.text:
2. The petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with the case registered under Sections
406/420/467/468/471/34 Ipc has prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.

3.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as per the FIR, the accused persons are involved in extra payment of Rs.56,90,754/- made to M/s Super Star Security Pvt. Ltd., Dhanbad which was engaged by Kolhan University, Chaibasa as outsourcing agency for supply of man power.
It is further submitted that the petitioner is merely a routine clerk and he has no role in making extra payment to the said Agency.
It has surfaced in the enquiry report that the said Agency is the beneficiary of the excess payment.
Moreover, it had issued wrong invoices and had taken extra payment.
Despite the said clear finding in the enquiry report, the said Agency has not yet been made accused in the present case.
4. Learned A.P.P is directed to procure the case diary from his end and to file counter affidavit within three weeks.

5. Put up this case on 12.08.2024 under the heading ''For Admission''.
6.
Till then, no coercive step shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Chaibasa Muffasil P.S. Case No. 69/2024, pending in the Court of the A.C.J.M, Chaibasa.
